r: wlfreerdp is a wayland Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) client which is part of the FreeRDP project. A RDP server is built-in to many editions of Windows. Alternative servers included xrdp and VRDP (VirtualBox).

The wayland client also supports a lot of the default client options which are not described here. For details on those see the xfreerdp(1) man page.

/v:<server>[:port]
The server hostname or IP, and optionally the port, to connect to.
/version
Print the version and exit.
/help
Print the help and exit.
